title: 成都【赵雷】

transcriptions.input: 让我掉下眼泪的 不止昨夜的酒
transcriptions.en: What made me shed tears was not just last night's wine.
transcriptions.pinyin: ràng wǒ diào xià yǎn lèi de, bù zhǐ zuó yè de jiǔ
transcriptions.chinglish: Let me fall down tears, not only last night wine.

transcriptions.input: 让我依依不舍的 不止你的温柔
transcriptions.en: What makes me reluctant to leave is not just your tenderness.
transcriptions.pinyin: ràng wǒ yī yī bù shě de, bù zhǐ nǐ de wēn róu
transcriptions.chinglish: Let me reluctant to leave, not only your gentle soft.

transcriptions.input: 余路还要走多久 你攥着我的手
transcriptions.en: How much longer must we walk this road, with you holding my hand?
transcriptions.pinyin: yú lù hái yào zǒu duō jiǔ nǐ zuàn zhe wǒ de shǒu
transcriptions.chinglish: Remaining road still need walk how long, you hold tight my hand.

transcriptions.input: 让我感到为难的 是挣扎的自由
transcriptions.en: What makes me feel troubled is the struggle for freedom.
transcriptions.pinyin: ràng wǒ gǎndào wéinán de shì zhēngzhá de zìyóu
transcriptions.chinglish: Let me feel difficult one, is struggle freedom.

transcriptions.input: 分别总是在九月 回忆是思念的愁
transcriptions.en: Partings always happen in September, memories are the sorrow of longing.
transcriptions.pinyin: fēn bié zǒng shì zài jiǔ yuè huí yì shì sī niàn de chóu
transcriptions.chinglish: Separate always is September, memory is miss of sad.

transcriptions.input: 深秋嫩绿的垂柳 亲吻着我额头
transcriptions.en: In deep autumn, the tender green weeping willows kiss my forehead.
transcriptions.pinyin: shēn qiū nèn lǜ de chuí liǔ qīn wěn zhe wǒ é tóu
transcriptions.chinglish: Deep autumn tender green hang willow, kiss kiss my forehead.

transcriptions.input: 在那座阴雨的小城里 我从未忘记你
transcriptions.en: In that rainy little town, I never forgot you.
transcriptions.pinyin: zài nà zuò yīn yǔ de xiǎo chéng lǐ wǒ cóng wèi wàng jì nǐ
transcriptions.chinglish: In that piece cloudy rain small city inside, I never forget you.

transcriptions.input: 成都 带不走的 只有你
transcriptions.en: In Chengdu, the only thing I can't take away is you.
transcriptions.pinyin: Chéngdū dài bù zǒu de zhǐ yǒu nǐ
transcriptions.chinglish: Chengdu take not go, only have you.

transcriptions.input: 和我在成都的街头走一走
transcriptions.en: Take a walk with me on the streets of Chengdu
transcriptions.pinyin: hé wǒ zài chéngdū de jiētóu zǒu yī zǒu
transcriptions.chinglish: With me in Chengdu street head walk walk.

transcriptions.input: 直到所有的灯都熄灭了也不停留
transcriptions.en: Until all the lights go out, still not stopping.
transcriptions.pinyin: zhí dào suǒ yǒu de dēng dōu xī miè le yě bù tíng liú
transcriptions.chinglish: Until all lights all extinguish also not stop stay.

transcriptions.input: 你会挽着我的衣袖 我会把手揣进裤兜
transcriptions.en: You'll hold onto my sleeve, and I'll tuck my hands into my pockets.
transcriptions.pinyin: nǐ huì wǎn zhe wǒ de yī xiù, wǒ huì bǎ shǒu chuāi jìn kù dōu
transcriptions.chinglish: You will hold my sleeve, I will put hand into pants pocket.

transcriptions.input: 走到玉林路的尽头 坐在小酒馆的门口
transcriptions.en: Walk to the end of Yulin Road and sit at the entrance of the small tavern
transcriptions.pinyin: zǒu dào yù lín lù de jìn tóu, zuò zài xiǎo jiǔ guǎn de mén kǒu
transcriptions.chinglish: Walk to Yulin Road end, sit at small wine shop door.
